title: Priority Lane
heading: BadCode Shorts ▲ Priority Lane
moodboard_intro: Round 7: the poster close-up for the transition. You picked PS6-c; these are close-ups of that same magenta poster, the start frame of the poster-to-car move (it ends on MIN1-b, him in the car). Pick one.

beats.name: A. Losing him
beats.blurb: Inside the ambulance at ER pace: a masked paramedic over the patient, 'BP 60 over 30, we're gonna lose him!'; the driver: 'Come on, get out of the way!'; the monitor racing.

beats.name: A2. His poster (cut into A)
beats.blurb: While the crew shout, quick cuts out to the minister's own SAVE OUR NHS campaign poster, at a bus shelter or on a bus, held ~1.5-2 s to read; then the poster close-up turns into him in the back of his car in the same pose (phone to right ear), and back to the ambulance (Jack, 2026-11-14).

beats.name: B. Held
beats.blurb: The light goes red; a police outrider's raised glove stops the ambulance. 'What's he doing?!'

beats.name: C. The motorcade
beats.blurb: The minister's car crosses slowly, right in front of the ambulance; he's on the phone: 'I said raspberry-shaped hors d'oeuvres!' Bolder: seen through the ambulance windscreen, inches away, his line heard through the glass.

beats.name: D. Flatline
beats.blurb: Back inside: the monitor goes flat. Hold a beat, then black and the BadCode logo (official file, laid on in the edit).

r2.what: round 2 agreed by Jack ('its done'): V1 five original Omni clips with in/out, V2 headline+logo overlay (alpha ProRes, 720x1280), A1 reporter lines, A2 minister (lip-synced), A3 clip ambience
r2.how: premiere-plan.py --tag r2 + place.js with a V2 overlay step; sequence 720x1280 from the Omni clips

r3.what: Round 3 rough cut with Jack's ending note (push into the flatline, logo on the screen); Premiere 26.5.2; Omni clips at Motion Scale 150 in a 1080x1920 sequence

r4.what: Round 4b, Jack: 'Priority Lane is great'. His SAVE OUR NHS poster cut into beat A (shelter shot at 2x), the poster face dissolving into him in the car on the matched pose (baked v2-losing-transition.mp4), then round 3 as before. Omni clips at Motion Scale 150.
r4.how: premiere-plan.py --tag r4 --seq + place.js via premiere_eval; Scale 150 on v0:0, v0:3, v0:4, v0:5

check.why: 7 shots and 12 audio clips placed as the edl; frames checked at 1, 2.5, 3.7, 6, 9, 12, 18.5 s

beats_r1.name: A. The whole outside view
beats_r1.blurb: The junction: the outrider's raised glove, the ambulance held at the red light, the motorcade coming through.

beats_r1.name: B. Inside the ambulance
beats_r1.blurb: The crew with the patient, the red light and the stopped traffic through the windscreen.

beats_r1.name: C. The BadCode reporter
beats_r1.blurb: On the pavement, mic in hand, to camera, with all of it behind.

beats_r1.name: D. Inside the minister's car
beats_r1.blurb: Back seat, on the phone, furious about lemon curd; blue lights through the rain.

picked: A2. His poster (through the ambulance window)
C. The motorcade (round 1 minister, clip pl-04 + lip-sync)
